title: On Protecting the children from the cold
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：protect　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 protect 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the baker ① protected the children from the cold at once, and every customer in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the baker ② protects the children from the cold in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ protect the children from the cold at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ protected the children from the cold before — a line in the bill for December 1943 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Protecting the children from the cold at once, the baker said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ protect the books from the damp in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Protect the books from the damp at once and never mention it again.

By 1956 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the bill, and a new customer from the next bakery ⑧ protects the books from the damp at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the oven, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ protected the children from the cold again when nobody else would.

⑩ To protect the children from the cold, my mother said in 1961, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the bakery remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the bakery forgets, somebody protects the children from the cold in the rain again and somebody must protect the children from the cold at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 保护（一般过去式 protected the children from the cold：1949 年面点师头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 保护（一般现在 protects the children from the cold：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 保护（不定式 to protect the children from the cold：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 保护（过去完成时 had protected the children from the cold：1943 年十二月的账单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 保护（动名词 protecting the children from the cold 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 护住（protect the books from the damp：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去护住把那些书从潮气里护住）
G. v. 护住（protect the books from the damp：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 保护（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 protects the books from the damp，而母亲又一次 protected the children from the cold）

answers.why: protect 意为“保护”，1949 年面点师二话不说地保护不让孩子们受冻，那是糕饼铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 protected。
protect 意为“保护”，自那以后面点师淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 protects。
protect 意为“保护”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯保护不让孩子们受冻”，此处为不定式 to protect the children from the cold。
protect 意为“保护”，账单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1956 年之前就有人保护过，故用过去完成时 had protected。
protect 意为“保护”，面点师说“保护不让孩子们受冻这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 protecting the children from the cold 作主语。
protect 意为“护住”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去护住把那些书从潮气里护住”，should ever 之后用原形 protect the books from the damp。
protect 意为“护住”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻护住把那些书从潮气里护住（protect the books from the damp at once），以后再也不要提起。
protect 意为“保护”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例护住把那些书从潮气里护住，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 protects。
protect 意为“保护”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地保护不让孩子们受冻，用一般过去式 protected 叙述。
protect 意为“保护”，结尾那句是母亲 1961 年的话：要保护不让孩子们受冻，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和糕饼铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 protect 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the baker protected the children from the cold at once, and nobody in the bakery forgot it.
Even now the baker protects the children from the cold in the rain whenever the bakery asks.
Protecting the children from the cold at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever protect the books from the damp in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next bakery protects the books from the damp at once every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother protected the children from the cold again, and the bakery remembered that half.
